content:
❌ Rejected the contribution.
Comment: It has a problem with the binary output and some other minor issues that I've described in my comment below.
Until those fixed I don't think it should be approved.
I recommend making it a WIP for now.

Very nice puzzle.

Difficulty talk is irrelevant. It's not too easy for sure.
"you can solve in one line" is not an argument for anything. A <200rank player can solve it in under 2 minutes and a solution is not that complex? On no! A quick, original yet simple puzzle in my CoC. Good lord, we cannot allow that.


It does have some other problems tho.

Aren't the first validator and the first test exactly the same?

> Output
> Convex / Non-convex
It's not an output description, that's two words with a slash

Also, guidelines got changed so the binary output should be avoided. 

You're using "shape" and "drawing" and "characters" yet you never connect those terms explicitly. You need to establish that the given shape is on the drawing and that given characters are used in the drawing.


> Characters used : / and \
Also, spaces.
And decorate used chars with {{ }} or just " " or whatever you prefer.

Constrains allow N to be 1 and 31 yet there are no tests for that.

Please consider adding it to shortest. I wanna beat Andre

The idea is good but you can solve in one line of python code:

print(['Convex','Non-convex'][any(len(input().replace(' ',''))>2 for _ in range(int(input())))])

I think you should also use '|' and '_' as characters, it would be more interesting

Thank you! I figured it could be done faster but I'm not really good and didn't bother.
I'll add the 2 chars you mentioned when I have the time :)
Thank you so much, it's my first contribution. I'll improve it when I can!

That's what I thought, I  was tempted to use _ and | but it makes it a little harder. I don't know how hard it's supposed to be.
Thank you for the code.
What if some people don't know convexity?
